standard.summary: 控制扩层后哪些参数参与训练：new_layers 只训练新增层（标准 DUS 配方）；new_layers_periphery 额外训练外围模块；all 训练全部参数。
standard.effect: new_layers：冻结原有层，只有新增层可训练；new_layers_periphery：在此基础上解冻 x_embedder、时间/文本嵌入与输出层；all：整个 DiT 参与训练（成本最高）。
standard.whenToUse: 默认 new_layers 最稳；需要输入/输出适配一起动时用 new_layers_periphery；数据充足且资源允许时才考虑 all。
standard.avoidWhen: all 范围显存开销最大且容易破坏原模型能力，小数据集慎用。

standard_en.summary: Sets which parameters train after expansion: new_layers trains only the added layers (the standard DUS recipe); new_layers_periphery adds the peripheral modules; all trains everything.
standard_en.effect: new_layers freezes the original layers so only the new ones are trainable; new_layers_periphery additionally unfreezes x_embedder, the time and text embeddings and the output layer; all puts the whole DiT in training (the most expensive option).
standard_en.whenToUse: new_layers is the safest default; use new_layers_periphery when the input/output adaptation has to move too; consider all only with plenty of data and resources.
standard_en.avoidWhen: The all scope costs the most VRAM and can easily damage the original model's abilities, so treat it with care on a small dataset.

advanced.principle: 冻结源层保持原有能力不漂移，新增层从恒等起点学习增量容量；外围模块解冻用于适配新深度下的输入输出分布。
advanced.intervention: krea2_depth_expansion_runtime.py：apply_train_scope 按元数据设置 requires_grad 并输出 trainable_ratio。
advanced.expectedImpact: 训练范围越大可塑性越强、成本与遗忘风险也越高。
advanced.tradeoffs: new_layers 最省显存但容量增量有限；all 等价于扩层后全参微调。

advanced_en.principle: Freezing source layers keeps original capability from drifting; new layers learn incremental capacity from an identity start; unfreezing periphery modules adapts input/output distributions to the new depth.
advanced_en.intervention: krea2_depth_expansion_runtime.py: apply_train_scope sets requires_grad from the metadata and reports trainable_ratio.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Larger scopes are more malleable but cost more and carry higher forgetting risk.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: new_layers is the most VRAM-friendly but limited in capacity gain; all equals full fine-tuning after expansion.
